unverified_requirements.text: Reconstruct the running shoe: the curved textile upper, open collar and padded heel, tongue, laces through their eyelets, layered midsole and outsole, and the main side-panel shapes. Preserve the toe taper, sole thickness changes and the real gaps beneath crossing laces. Match the grey knit, dark accents and sole materials. Tiny knit stitches, exact brand lettering and tread hidden from the supplied view are not exact targets.

Image planes or camera-facing shells are not substitutes for full geometry.
